prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A hyper-realistic, cinematic close-up of a human hand interacting with a smartphone screen. The focus is on a single finger, with a well-manicured nail, gently pressing the play button on a music or media player interface. The screen displays crisp, modern UI elements, including a progress bar and playback controls, rendered in cool blue and white tones. The lighting is soft and natural, creating subtle reflections and highlights on the fingertip and the glossy surface of the phone. The background is softly blurred, with hints of a patterned fabric in warm, muted colors, suggesting a cozy indoor setting. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, drawing attention to the tactile moment of touch and the sleek technology, evoking a sense of intimacy and everyday modern life. The camera angle is low and intimate, almost at the level of the device, emphasizing the interaction and the textures of skin and glass.
